punchline: Churchill took up painting after Gallipoli, and Alex Pang treats it as rest that works like work.
thirty_sec: In 1915, after the Gallipoli campaign, Winston Churchill lost his post at the Admiralty and started to paint. Alex Pang uses it as his main case of deep play: an activity that is absorbing, rewarding on its own, and uses some work skills in a new setting. Churchill wrote that the tired parts of the mind can be rested and strengthened, not merely by rest, but by using other parts.
